name: VoronoiField - Default
description: Space partitioned by nearest neighbour, drawn at the 200x365 flank lane it stands in (FLANK_LANE). Unlike the harmonograph this field is GENERATED at the lane and rendered with preserveAspectRatio="none", so the frame IS the lane: a mismatch here would not letterbox, it would smear every cell horizontally. At 3-4 columns against 5-7 rows the cells should read as roughly square rather than stretched wide. Two deliberate incompletenesses have to be legible: one cell drawn an edge short, and one or two small crosses marking sites the partition has not accounted for at all.
